description: Who Gets Heard?When I first ran for Congress in 2018, I made a decision: I wouldn’t take any corporate PAC money.People told me I was crazy. They said I’d never raise enough to compete. And they were mostly right. I didn’t raise as much as the big-name candidates.But something else happened.I got to look every donor in the eye. I got to hear their stories.
